about.label: About RFALA
about.title: Two decades of technology. One ecosystem built for the future.
paragraphs: What started in 2006 as ryztech.com has grown into RFALA, a full technology and innovation ecosystem with Moroccan roots and global ambitions.
Over 20 years, we have built digital products, helped businesses grow online, developed platforms, and invested in education and community impact across multiple industries.
Today, RFALA operates through focused initiatives: Xenova Studio, Maroclist, Islamic School Review, and RFALA Institute, each solving real problems for businesses, learners, and communities.
RFALA is not just a company. It is an ecosystem built on two decades of experience, designed to create, innovate, and shape the future.

water.title: WaterAgent by RFALA | Groundwater Evidence Reports for Morocco
water.description: WaterAgent shows what groundwater evidence exists for a location in Morocco, what is missing, and what to investigate next, in a printable preliminary report. Pilot stage. It does not predict groundwater.

visuals.evidenceAlt: Illustration of a WaterAgent evidence summary, modelled on the sample report: terrain, climate and rainfall, and geology and aquifer are available; regional water-storage trend and wells and monitoring points are missing. Next step: consult a qualified local hydrogeologist.

water.name: WaterAgent
water.tagline: Groundwater evidence reports for locations in Morocco
water.summary: Pick a location in Morocco and WaterAgent shows which evidence exists for it, such as terrain, rainfall, and regional geology, what is missing, and what to investigate next, in a printable preliminary report. It does not predict groundwater. Pilot stage, covering one test area.
description: WaterAgent is a decision-support web app for groundwater questions in Morocco. You pick a location, and it reports which evidence is available for that spot: terrain (elevation and slope), climate and rainfall, and regional geology and aquifer context.

It is just as clear about what is missing, such as records of nearby wells, and it lists what to investigate next, such as consulting a qualified local hydrogeologist or asking the Hydraulic Basin Agency (ABH) for existing records. The result is a printable preliminary report.
WaterAgent is at pilot stage. It currently covers one test area, Oulad Teima in Morocco, and its data layers have not yet been reviewed by a hydrogeologist.
workflow: Pick a location in the pilot area
See which evidence exists and what is missing
water.capabilitiesNote: Pilot stage: one test area (Oulad Teima, Morocco). Data layers have not yet been reviewed by a hydrogeologist.
capabilities: Each input marked as available or missing
water.noteTitle: Decision support, not a groundwater prediction.
water.noteBody: WaterAgent does not predict whether groundwater is present, at what depth, or in what quantity, and it does not replace a qualified hydrogeological investigation. Use the report to prepare that investigation, not to decide where to drill.

advisory.label: Service
advisory.name: Technology & Product Advisory
advisory.tagline: Turn your technology investment into the right product.
advisory.intro: RFALA provides independent technology and product oversight for businesses working with developers, freelancers, or technology teams.
body: We bridge the gap between the business owner and the development team, helping translate your vision into clear requirements, manage priorities and timelines, review quality and deliverables, and keep the product aligned with your business objectives.

Beyond project management, RFALA's founder brings more than 30 years of hands-on experience in IT, AI, data, and enterprise technology, helping identify opportunities, improve the product, and guide technology decisions from concept through delivery.
advisory.independence: Independent oversight. RFALA works on your behalf alongside the developers you choose. We do not replace your development team.
provide: Final delivery and product readiness review
advisory.ideal: Businesses that have an idea, product, or active development project and want an experienced technology partner to help ensure the right product is built and delivered successfully.
advisory.closing: Your idea. Your investment. Your product. RFALA helps keep it aligned with the value you envisioned.
